BILEL MILED
FullStack Developer specialized in React and Flutter (Dart) for modern web and cross-platform applications, and Express.js for backend development. Holding a diploma in Computer Science with a focus on mobile development.
https://bilelmiled.github.io                                  +216 23 833 995                                  linkedin.com/bilel-miled
ACADEMIC PROJECTS
PROJECTS
Padel E-commerce (B2C) , Mars 2025 - Present
Architected a dynamic product catalog using React and Vite , featuring advanced real-time filtering by price range, brand, and category to enhance user navigation.
Engineered a responsive and high-conversion UI with Tailwind CSS , including custom-built components like a dual-thumb price slider and automated stock status indicators.
Integrated a secure RESTful backend using Express.js and MongoDB for centralized product management, user orders, and real-time database synchronization.
Used Git for version control and Asana for project management and task tracking.
PROFESSIONAL EXPERIENCE
EXPERIENCE
Flutter developer intern , IT Gate, SEP 2025 - OCT 2025
Design, UX, and development of a job platform application allowing companies to create and manage job offers and candidate applications.
Development of the backend using Express.js and MongoDB, managing data storage, authentication, and communication between the client and server.
Game Developer , Herodot Studio, DEC 2021 - SEP 2024
Design, development, and maintenance of video games.
CERTIFICATES (IN PROGRESS)
CERTIFICATIONS
React.js Development, Udemy, FEB 2026
Completed an in-depth training in React.js including Hooks, Context API
Built modern web applications using Next.js with server-side rendering and routing.
Implemented global state management using Redux.
Developed scalable and type-safe applications using TypeScript.
FullStack Mobile Development (Flutter + Node.js & Express), JobGate, AUG 2025
Developed mobile applications with Flutter (frontend) connected to a Node.js & Express backend
Designed and consumed REST APIs for communication between mobile apps and backend services.
Applied state management with GetX to handle navigation, data flow, and app scalability.

September 2015 - June 2021
Diploma in Computer Science, Private Higher School of Engineering and Technology (ESPRIT)

LANGUAGES
